dialogs.content: Right, there you are! All your Xiao Lantern parts, crafted to order, and every piece individually waterproofed.
Each is wrapped in five to six layers of oilpaper, so you could toss 'em in a pond to soak for a week or so and they'd still be fine.
Thank you for your diligence. Rest assured, I shall compensate you for your labor and expenditures in full. After all, procuring all this when it isn't Lantern Rite must be quite the hassle.
It was nothing, really! No need to be so polite! Doing business means always putting the customer's needs first and foremost!
Oh, right! How did you find the tea you bought last time? Could I interest you in some Chenyu Adeptea as well? We just got a new batch in, freshly dried! Top-notch stuff, every leaf!
I see. If there's a discount, then...
Right, there you are! All your Xiao Lantern parts, crafted to order, and every piece individually waterproofed.
Each is wrapped in five to six layers of oilpaper, so you could toss 'em in a pond to soak for a week or so and they'd still be fine.
My thanks for your diligence. Rest assured, I shall compensate you for your labor and expenditures in full.
Come on, my good fellow! No need to be so polite! Doing business means always putting the customer's needs first and foremost!
Oh, right! How did you find the tea you bought last time? Could I interest you in some Chenyu Adeptea as well? We just got a new batch in, freshly dried! Top-notch stuff, every leaf!
I see. If there's a discount, then...
Hold it right there, Neuvillette! You can't go buying stuff just 'cause they say there's a discount!
You didn't even finish the tea you bought last time!
#{NICKNAME}? Paimon? Now this is a coincidence. I had just been wondering if you would come to Liyue Harbor for the festival. I wish you a happy Lantern Rite.
Hey, were you buying Xiao Lantern parts just now? And you even had him waterproof them, so does that mean...
Yes. I intend to gift these to the Melusines. They have never seen such lanterns before, and I'm sure they'll enjoy them.

I would still like to buy a few more to hang outside the Palais Mermonia. However, doing so would create a dilemma: Would it not be unfair that the Palais Mermonia is the only place with Xiao Lanterns?
Perhaps I should return and have the Gestionnaires make a bulk purchase, so Xiao Lanterns can be hung over the entire Court of Fontaine and Fortress of Meropide.
If you let the Gestionnaires handle it, we'll be lucky to hang up any Lanterns they buy before next year's Lantern Rite rolls around.
Also, point of caution, Your Honor — it might not be the best idea to hang them in Meropide.
They won't fly high within our walls, and I doubt many of the wishes the inmates'll write will have a chance of coming true.
They're unlikely to wish for anything in the public interest, anyway. Let's try and keep the Lanterns' reputation clean, yeah?
And as for the "good wishes" worth making, I've already sent them soaring on the inmates' behalf.
Heh, Lantern Festival's positively packed this year!
Oh, right. Happy Lantern Rite, everyone. Don't mind if I address you as a group, it's the thought that counts anyway.
Now, now, tradition dictates and all.
Hey! What's up with the "too" that Paimon got?
#Heh, Wriothesley, Miss Sigewinne, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. Allow me to wish you all a happy Lantern Rite as well.
This festival is wonderful indeed, to have brought us all together.
#Whoa, now this really feels like a party. Shame I didn't buy any of those Fortune Coin packets — otherwise, Liyue custom would've obliged us to hand one each to {NICKNAME} and Paimon.
A direct Mora injection into my coffers wouldn't hurt...
Hahaha, fine by me! Let's go grab something good later, I'm sure Paimon can lead the way!
Really? Haha, then Paimon's gonna go all out on the menu!
Won't you please join us as well, Monsieur Neuvillette?
Of course, I'm more than willing.
Hey, I just noticed... That's a sharp new outfit you've got there. Goes perfectly with the holiday cheer... and that relaxed expression you're wearing.
Hmm, Monsieur Neuvillette, looking at the weave and the ornamentation... If I'm not mistaken, this is Melusine handiwork.
Huh? You can tell?
Yep! Looking at the design, I'd say it's one of Flo's creations. Laume probably contributed a lot, too.
Anyway, it's dashing and elegant, and suits Monsieur Neuvillette well.
Indeed. This is a most precious gift the Melusines have given me.
Neuvillette recounts how the Melusines gave him his new outfit...
So, you're planning to give them Xiao Lanterns as a thank-you?
Yes. It is only polite to do so.
You can expect another thank-you gift from them, then.
Yes, I suppose they will do that.
Fair enough, gifts are gifts, after all. If your office starts drowning in them, though, you can send the overflow my way.
My head nurse here is excellent at taking care of Melusine gifts.
Hehe, leave it to me! I'll preserve their sentiments perfectly.
But first, why don't we find another place to stretch our legs?
Liyue's a beautiful place, and has a flavor completely unlike anything we're used to in Fontaine.
And I'm not just talking about the tea, mind you.
Happy Lantern Rite, Sigewinne.
Happy Lantern Rite, Wriothesley.
Happy Lantern Rite, Neuvillette!
Happy Lantern Rite to you too, Paimon!
